entries_new.mechanism: France created a republic from part of a bishop-ruled territory it occupied.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list calls the Rauracian Republic a short-lived French occupation zone around the Jura Mountains in what is now Switzerland. It was created in 1792 from the northern part of the Prince-Bishopric of Basel, which belonged to the Holy Roman Empire. The list gives no capital.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Bolognese Republic
entries_new.mechanism: A city and neighbouring province were merged into a republic in 1796.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the Bolognese Republic was created in 1796 in the central Italian city of Bologna. It merged the existing provinces of Bologna and Ferrara into one. Bologna was its capital. The list says the territory is now part of Italy and gives no end date or later history.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Cispadane Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Merger with the Transpadane Republic into the Cisalpine Republic
entries_new.mechanism: A French-protected client republic was founded in northern Italy.
entries_new.story: The Cispadane Republic was a short-lived client republic in northern Italy, founded in 1796 under the protection of the French army led by Napoleon Bonaparte. Wikipedia's list says it merged in 1797 with the Transpadane Republic to form the Cisalpine Republic, and that it was the first Italian sovereign state to adopt the Italian tricolour flag.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Transpadane Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Merger into the Cisalpine Republic
entries_new.mechanism: France set up an allied republic in Milan.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Transpadane Republic as a sister republic of France established in Milan from 1796 to 1797. Elsewhere the list says it merged in 1797 with the Cispadane Republic to form the Cisalpine Republic. A sister republic was a state set up by revolutionary France and tied to it.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Republic of Crema
entries_new.mechanism: A town proclaimed itself a republic when French troops arrived.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Republic of Crema as a revolutionary municipality in Lombardy, created when the French Army entered Crema on 28 March 1797. The list gives Crema as its capital and 1797 as its date.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Republic of Brescia
entries_new.stopped_by: Absorbed into the Cisalpine Republic on 20 November 1797
entries_new.mechanism: A city proclaimed a republic under French occupation.
entries_new.story: The Republic of Brescia was a temporary French client republic in Italy, established on 18 March 1797 after the French occupation of Brescia and Bergamo. Wikipedia's list says it became part of the Cisalpine Republic on 20 November 1797.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Republic of Bergamo
entries_new.mechanism: A city became a short-lived republic under French occupation.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states describes the Republic of Bergamo as a short-lived French client republic centred on Bergamo. A client republic is a state that depends on a stronger power. The list's entry for neighbouring Brescia says the French occupied Bergamo in 1797, but gives no more detail for Bergamo itself.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Ligurian Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Napoleon replaced the Republic of Genoa with a French client republic.
entries_new.story: Napoleon formed the Ligurian Republic on 14 June 1797 as a French client republic. Wikipedia's list says it consisted of the old Republic of Genoa, which covered most of the Ligurian region of north-west Italy, together with small imperial fiefs owned by the House of Savoy inside that territory. Genoa was its capital. The list gives 1805 as its end.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Tiberina Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Absorbed into the Roman Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Republicans took power in Perugia and named a republic after the Tiber.
entries_new.story: The Tiberina Republic was a revolutionary municipality proclaimed on 4 February 1798 when republicans took power in the city of Perugia. Wikipedia's list says it took its name from the river Tiber, and that a month later the government of all the Papal States became a republic, the Roman Republic, which Perugia belonged to.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Republic of Connacht
entries_new.mechanism: French forces backed a republic in the west of Ireland.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states describes the Republic of Connacht as a French client republic, with Castlebar as its capital, in what is now Ireland. A client republic is a state that depends on a stronger power. The list gives no dates or further detail.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Lemanic Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Incorporated into the Helvetic Republic in April 1798
entries_new.mechanism: A territory governed by Bern declared its independence.
entries_new.story: The Lemanic Republic was formerly a subject territory of Bern, in what is now Switzerland. Wikipedia's list says it declared independence in January 1798 and was incorporated in April of the same year into the Helvetic Republic as the Canton of Léman, today Vaud. Lausanne was its capital.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Roman Republic (1798 to 1799)
entries_new.mechanism: Republicans replaced the papal government when the pope left Rome.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the Roman Republic was declared on 15 February 1798, when a republican government temporarily replaced the government of the Papal States after Pope Pius VI left for France, where he later died. The list gives Rome as its capital and 1798 to 1799 as its dates.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: State of Lucca
entries_new.mechanism: A small republic negotiated with Napoleon to keep its independence.
entries_new.story: After the war of the First Coalition ended with the Treaty of Campo Formio, the government of the Republic of Lucca negotiated with the new Cisalpine Republic to keep its independence, according to Wikipedia's list. The jurist Luigi Matteucci was sent to Milan to negotiate with Napoleon. The list gives the State of Lucca as lasting in 1799.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Republic of Pescara
entries_new.mechanism: Jacobins set up a government in a fortress city as a French client.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Republic of Pescara as the short-lived provisional Jacobin government set up in the fortress city of Pescara in 1799. It was a client state of the French First Republic and part of the wider Parthenopean Republic.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Harbin Soviet of Workers and Soldiers Deputies
entries_new.mechanism: Russian workers and soldiers formed a council to take over a railway.
entries_new.story: The Harbin Soviet was a council of Russian workers and soldiers in Harbin at the time of the 1917 Russian Revolution, founded right after Tsar Nicholas II abdicated. Wikipedia's list says it sought to seize control of the Chinese Eastern Railway and to defend Russian citizens in Manchuria.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Far Eastern Soviet Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Soviet Russia set up a nominally independent buffer state in the Far East.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes this as a nominally independent state that existed from April 1920 to November 1922 in the easternmost part of the Russian Far East. It largely came under the control of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic, which saw it as a buffer state between itself and the territories occupied by Japan during the Russian Civil War.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Khorezm People's Soviet Republic
entries_new.mechanism: A soviet republic replaced a khanate in Central Asia.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states says the Khorezm People's Soviet Republic existed from 1920 to 1924, with Khiva as its capital, and succeeded the Khanate of Khiva. Its territory is now in Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Bukharan People's Soviet Republic
entries_new.mechanism: A soviet republic replaced an emirate in Central Asia.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the Bukharan People's Soviet Republic, centred on Bukhara, succeeded the Emirate of Bukhara. Its territory is now in Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan and Tajikistan. The list gives Bukhara as its capital and does not date it.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Baku Soviet Commune
entries_new.stopped_by: A coalition of Dashnaks, Right SRs and Mensheviks on 26 July 1918
entries_new.mechanism: Bolsheviks took power in a city that was the capital of another independent state.
entries_new.story: The Baku Soviet Commune was established in Baku, then the capital of the briefly independent Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. Wikipedia's list says it was led by Stepan Shahumyan and lasted until 26 July 1918, when Dashnaks, Right Socialist Revolutionaries and Mensheviks forced the Bolsheviks out of power.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Terek Soviet Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Bolsheviks set up a soviet republic in a former Russian Empire province.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Terek Soviet Republic as a short-lived republic on the territory of the former Terek Oblast in Russia. Its capital was first Pyatigorsk and later Vladikavkaz. The North Caucasian Soviet Republic later absorbed it with two other soviet republics.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Don Soviet Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Bolsheviks proclaimed a soviet republic in the Don region.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Don Soviet Republic as a short-lived Soviet republic of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic that existed from March to May 1918, with Rostov-on-Don as its capital. The list gives no further detail on how it began or ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: North Caucasian Soviet Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: White Movement offensive and abolition by the All-Russian Central Executive Committee in 1919
entries_new.mechanism: Three soviet republics merged to hold Communist influence in the region.
entries_new.story: This republic merged the Kuban-Black Sea, Stavropol and Terek soviet republics to consolidate Communist influence in the North Caucasus. Wikipedia's list says that after the Volunteer Army captured Yekaterinodar, the White Movement attacked its territory, and in 1919 the All-Russian Central Executive Committee abolished the republic.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Crimean Socialist Soviet Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Soviet Russia backed a local socialist state in Crimea.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Crimean Socialist Soviet Republic as a state allied with Soviet Russia that existed in Crimea for several months in 1919 during the Russian Civil War. Simferopol was its capital. The list gives no further detail on how it began or ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Mughan Soviet Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Pro-Bolshevik forces proclaimed a state in south-eastern Azerbaijan.
entries_new.story: The Mughan Soviet Republic was a short-lived pro-Bolshevik state in present-day south-eastern Azerbaijan, which existed from March to June 1919, according to Wikipedia's list. Lankaran was its capital. The list gives no further detail on how it began or ended, or on who led it.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Chyhyryn Soviet Republic
entries_new.mechanism: A local soviet state was declared during the Ukrainian War of Independence.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Chyhyryn Soviet Republic as an unrecognised Soviet state from the Ukrainian War of Independence, with Chyhyryn as its capital, in what is now Ukraine. The list gives no dates and no further detail on who led it or how it ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Samarina Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Aromanians attempted a state.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list calls the Samarina Republic the first attempt at an Aromanian state. It existed in 1917 with Samarina as its capital, in what is now Greece. The list gives no further detail on who led it or how it ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: First Slovak Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Nazi Germany sponsored a nominally independent Slovak state.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states says that between 1939 and 1945 the First Slovak Republic was a puppet state of Nazi Germany, with Bratislava as its capital. A puppet state is one that formally governs itself but acts on the orders of a stronger power. The list notes it as an example of a state created as a puppet during wartime.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Wang Jingwei regime
entries_new.recognition: Empire of Japan and its allies
entries_new.mechanism: Japan sponsored a Chinese government in occupied territory.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Wang Jingwei regime, based in Nanjing, as a puppet government of the Empire of Japan that was dissolved at the end of the Second World War. The list says the Empire of Japan and its allies recognised it. The list gives 1940 to 1945 as its dates.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: State of Burma
entries_new.mechanism: Japan sponsored a nominally independent government in Burma.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states includes the State of Burma, with Yangon as its capital, in what is now Myanmar. The list describes it as a Japanese puppet state. It gives no dates and no further detail.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Empire of Vietnam
entries_new.mechanism: Japan sponsored a nominally independent Vietnamese state.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Empire of Vietnam, based in Huế, as a Japanese puppet state that preceded the Democratic Republic of Vietnam. A puppet state formally governs itself but acts on the orders of a stronger power. The list gives no dates and no further detail.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Kingdom of Kampuchea
entries_new.mechanism: Japan sponsored a nominally independent Cambodian state.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Kingdom of Kampuchea, with Phnom Penh as its capital, as a Japanese puppet state that preceded the second French protectorate of Cambodia. The list gives no dates and no further detail.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Kingdom of Laos (1945 to 1946)
entries_new.mechanism: A kingdom was declared in Laos at the end of the Second World War.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states gives the Kingdom of Laos as existing from 1945 to 1946 with Vientiane and Luang Prabang as capitals. It labels the entry a partisan state. The list gives no further detail on how it began or ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Italian Social Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Germany backed Mussolini in a northern Italian puppet state.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Italian Social Republic as a German-dominated puppet state under Benito Mussolini, formed in northern Italy after the Italian king Victor Emmanuel III signed an armistice with the Allies. Salò, Verona and Milan are named as its capitals, and it lasted from 1943 to 1945.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Lokot Autonomy
entries_new.mechanism: German forces set up a local administration during their invasion of the Soviet Union.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the Lokot Autonomy was established as a Nazi client state during Operation Barbarossa, the German invasion of the Soviet Union, with Lokot as its capital in Russia. A client state depends on a stronger power. The list gives 1941 to 1942 as its dates.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Ukrainian Independent United State
entries_new.mechanism: An insurgent army held territory in Western Ukraine.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes this as the territories of Western Ukraine controlled by the Ukrainian Insurgent Army during the Second World War. It gives Lviv, with a question mark, as the capital, and 1941 to 1949 as the dates. The list says the territory is now in Ukraine and Poland.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Belarusian Central Rada
entries_new.mechanism: Germany allowed a collaborationist council in occupied Belarus.
entries_new.story: The Belarusian Central Rada was a puppet administrative body in German-occupied Belarus. Wikipedia's list says Nazi Germany established it within Reichskommissariat Ostland in 1943 and 1944, after requests from collaborationist Belarusian politicians who hoped to create a Belarusian state with German support. Minsk was its seat.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Principality of the Pindus
entries_new.mechanism: Aromanians attempted a state during the Second World War.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list calls the Principality of the Pindus the second attempt at an Aromanian state, after the Samarina Republic. It existed from 1941 to 1943 in what is now Greece. The list gives a question mark for its capital and no further detail on how it began or ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Ukrainian State Board
entries_new.stopped_by: Suppression by Nazi Germany
entries_new.mechanism: A nationalist organisation proclaimed a Ukrainian state in the first days of German occupation.
entries_new.story: After Nazi Germany occupied Lviv, the Organization of Ukrainian Nationalists proclaimed the restoration of Ukrainian statehood in 1941, Wikipedia's list says. Nazi Germany suppressed it immediately. The list names Lviv as its capital, in what is now Ukraine, and gives 1941 as its only date.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Great Way Government
entries_new.mechanism: Japan sponsored a municipal government for occupied Shanghai.
entries_new.story: The Great Way or Dadao Government, formally the Great Way Municipal Government of Shanghai, was a short-lived puppet government proclaimed in Pudong on 5 December 1937. Wikipedia's list says it was set up to administer Japanese-occupied Shanghai in the early stages of the Second Sino-Japanese War.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: South Chahar Autonomous Government
entries_new.stopped_by: Merged with the other two Mengjiang parts after infighting
entries_new.mechanism: Japan backed a Mongolian autonomous government in occupied northern China.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list calls this another regional puppet state of Japan, set up after the Second Sino-Japanese War began, with Kalgan as its capital. It was one of three parts of the Mengjiang state, meant to represent ethnic Mongolians. Infighting among the three led to a merger into the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Republic of Užice
entries_new.stopped_by: German Army in the first anti-partisan offensive
entries_new.mechanism: Yugoslav partisans held a liberated area after the invasion.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Republic of Užice as an area briefly liberated by Yugoslav partisans after the invasion of Yugoslavia. The German Army retook it during the first anti-partisan offensive. Užice, in present-day Serbia, was its capital.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Bihać Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Recapture by the German Army
entries_new.mechanism: Yugoslav partisans held a liberated area.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the Bihać Republic was an area liberated by Yugoslav partisans before the German Army recaptured it. Bihać was its capital, and the list places the territory in Croatia and Bosnia and Herzegovina. It gives 1942 to 1943 as the dates.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Kolky Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Attacks by Nazi and Soviet forces
entries_new.mechanism: The Ukrainian Insurgent Army seized a village area from the German occupiers.
entries_new.story: The Kolky Republic was a small parcel of land centred on the village of Kolky that the Ukrainian Insurgent Army seized from the German occupation in 1943. Wikipedia's list says Nazi and Soviet forces attacked it from both sides, and that up to 500 villagers died.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Free Republic of Vercors
entries_new.mechanism: Resistance fighters proclaimed a free territory in the mountains.
entries_new.story: On 3 July 1944 the Free Republic of Vercors was proclaimed at Vassieux-en-Vercors, in France. Wikipedia's list calls it the first democratic territory in France since the German occupation began in 1940. The republic ceased to exist before the end of the same month.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Red Republic of Caulonia
entries_new.mechanism: A town proclaimed a socialist republic in 1945.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states describes the Red Republic of Caulonia as a short-lived socialist state in Italy, in the town of Caulonia, in 1945. The list gives no further detail on who led it or how it ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Free Republic of Schwarzenberg
entries_new.stopped_by: Soviet occupation
entries_new.mechanism: Districts that no army had yet occupied governed themselves for weeks.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Free Republic of Schwarzenberg as a term applied to parts of western Saxony that were briefly not occupied by the Allies after the German surrender on 8 May 1945. These districts governed themselves for several weeks before Soviet occupation.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Zuyev Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Old Believer villages formed a self-governing area under German occupation.
entries_new.story: The Zuyev Republic was an autonomous government in German-occupied Byelorussia near Polotsk, made up mainly of villages of Old Believers, a Russian Orthodox group. Wikipedia's list says it was named for its starosta, Mikhail Yevseyevich Zuyev. A militia of about 100 permanent soldiers was raised, and private property was restored and Old Believer churches reopened.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Sicily (1848 to 1849)
entries_new.mechanism: A revolution in Sicily set up a separate state.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states describes Sicily in 1848 and 1849 as an Italian revolutionary state established during the Revolutions of 1848, with Palermo as its capital. The list gives no further detail on who led it or how it ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Free State of Ikaria
entries_new.mechanism: Islanders proclaimed their own state in 1912.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Free State of Ikaria as a small, short-lived state on the island of Ikaria and neighbouring islands such as Fournoi Korseon, in what is now Greece. It existed in 1912, with Agios Kirykos as its capital.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: First East Turkestan Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Nationalists of the Republic of China
entries_new.mechanism: A movement for an independent Xinjiang proclaimed a republic in Kashgar.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the First East Turkestan Republic was set up in Kashgar as part of the movement for an independent Xinjiang. It existed from 1933 to 1934 and was defeated by the Nationalists of the Republic of China.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Hailufeng Soviet
entries_new.mechanism: Communist troops and a local leader set up a Soviet in the countryside.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list calls the Hailufeng Soviet the first Chinese Soviet territory. Peng Pai established it in November 1927 with the remaining troops of Ye Ting from the Nanchang Uprising. After the Little Long March and the Battle of Shantou, those troops were much reduced, and the Comintern told them to lie low in the countryside.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Potchefstroom Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Union with the Winburg Republic
entries_new.mechanism: A town-based republic set up in the 1830s that joined the neighbouring Winburg Republic.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states describes the Potchefstroom Republic, in what is now South Africa, as a republic that existed for only a couple of months before it joined the Winburg Republic. The list calls it effectively a city-state, meaning a state made up of one town and its surroundings.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Winburg Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Union with the Potchefstroom Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Settlers took land given by a local chief in return for protection, then joined a neighbouring republic.
entries_new.story: The Winburg Republic was set up in 1836 by Voortrekkers, Dutch-descended settlers moving inland from the Cape Colony. Wikipedia's list says the land on the Vet and Vaal Rivers was donated by the Bataung chief Makwana in exchange for protection from neighbouring Basotho. In 1838 it joined the new Potchefstroom Republic to form the Republic of Winburg-Potchefstroom.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Republic of Winburg-Potchefstroom
entries_new.stopped_by: Potchefstroom left the union
entries_new.mechanism: Two small settler republics merged into one in 1838.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states says this republic was formed in 1838 by the union of the Potchefstroom Republic and the Winburg Republic, both set up by Voortrekker settlers in what is now South Africa. It lasted until Potchefstroom left the union to join with Pietermaritzburg. The list gives no end date.
entries_new.anchor: Between Potchefstroom and Winburg, South Africa

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Andries-Ohrigstad Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Malaria; the site was abandoned in 1849
entries_new.mechanism: Voortrekkers built a fort and claimed a republic in the Transvaal region.
entries_new.story: A group of Voortrekkers under Andries Hendrik Potgieter established a fort with the help of a Dutch merchant, Gregorius Ohrig. Wikipedia's list says the settlers arrived in 1845 and were decimated by malaria. They were forced to leave the area, and the republic was officially abandoned in 1849.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Klip River Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: British annexation in 1847
entries_new.mechanism: Settlers bought land from the Zulu king and declared a republic.
entries_new.story: In 1847 Boer settlers bought land from the Zulu king Mpande and called the area the Republic of Klip River, with Andries Spies as commandant, or military leader. Wikipedia's list says the British annexed the republic in the same year.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Utrecht Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Union with the Lydenburg Republic in 1858
entries_new.mechanism: A land purchase from the Zulu king was followed by the proclamation of a settler republic.
entries_new.story: Andreas Theodorus Spies proclaimed the Utrecht Republic in 1854 after a land purchase from the Zulu king Mpande, according to Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states. The list says it joined with the Lydenburg Republic in 1858.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Lydenburg Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Incorporation into the South African Republic in 1860
entries_new.mechanism: Boer settlers formed a new republic from the remains of an earlier one.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the Lydenburg Republic was a Boer republic created after the Andries-Ohrigstad Republic dissolved. It grew by taking in the Utrecht Republic in 1858. In 1860 it was incorporated into the South African Republic.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Klipdrift Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Diamond diggers proclaimed a republic during a dispute over mining claims.
entries_new.story: The Klipdrift Republic was proclaimed in 1870 during a dispute over diamond mines near what would become Griqualand West, in present-day South Africa. Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states gives Barkly West as its capital. The list gives no end date.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Sultanate of Utetera
entries_new.mechanism: A slave trader set up a sultanate in the eastern Congo basin.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states gives the Sultanate of Utetera as existing from 1860 to 1887 with Kasongo as its capital, in what is now the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The list says it was founded by the slave trader Tippu Tip and gives no further detail.
entries_new.anchor: Kasongo, Democratic Republic of the Congo

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Colinsland
entries_new.stopped_by: Germany ceded the claim to France
entries_new.mechanism: A merchant claimed a colony on the Guinea coast with limited government backing.
entries_new.story: Colinsland was a disputed German colony in what is now Guinea. Wikipedia's list says it was begun by the German merchant Frederick Colin with limited support from the German government. Germany conceded the area to France, which already claimed it, in exchange for minor territories elsewhere in Africa and respect for Colin's commercial rights.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Zaian confederation
entries_new.stopped_by: French forces after the Treaty of Versailles
entries_new.mechanism: Berber tribes in the Middle Atlas fought the French conquest.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Zaian confederation as a confederation of Berber tribesmen in the interior of Morocco that resisted French conquest in the Middle Atlas mountains for several years. The list says the Central Powers supported it after the First World War began, and that it was subdued only after the Treaty of Versailles.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Sultanate of Darfur (1915 to 1916)
entries_new.stopped_by: 1916 Anglo-Egyptian Darfur Expedition
entries_new.mechanism: The sultan broke with Britain and backed the Ottoman Empire.
entries_new.story: Darfur was a protectorate of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan. Wikipedia's list says the Sultan, Ali Dinar, renounced his allegiance to the British Empire in support of the Ottoman Empire after the Ottomans entered the First World War against Britain. The rebellion was put down in the 1916 Anglo-Egyptian Darfur Expedition.

entries_new.name: Zefta Republic
entries_new.founder: Mohamed El Kafrawy Pasha and Youssef El Guindi
entries_new.mechanism: Townspeople declared independence in protest at the exile of nationalist leaders.
entries_new.story: In 1919 the British occupation expelled Saad Zaghloul Pasha and other leaders of the Wafd Party from Egypt and exiled them to Malta. Wikipedia's list says the people of Zefta, led by Mohamed El Kafrawy Pasha and Youssef El Guindi, gathered and declared independence from the crown and named the place the Zefta Republic.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Macha Oromo Confederation
entries_new.stopped_by: Italian army occupation within the year
entries_new.mechanism: Oromo leaders proclaimed a state and asked for British protection as Italy took over Ethiopia.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes this as a rump Oromo state in western Ethiopia, proclaimed after Italy won the Second Italo-Ethiopian War. It asked to be accepted as a British mandate territory to avoid annexation into the Italian Empire. No country recognised it, and the Italian army occupied it within the year.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Niger Delta Republic (1966)
entries_new.mechanism: A soldier and activist declared a republic in the Niger Delta.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states describes the Niger Delta Republic as a short-lived state declared in 1966 by Isaac Adaka Boro, a soldier and Niger Delta activist, in what is now Nigeria. The separatist movements list dates a Boro declaration to February 1965 and says it failed.

entries_new.name: Maquis of Fizi
entries_new.mechanism: Rebels held a zone after the Simba Rebellion failed.
entries_new.story: The Maquis of Fizi was a Marxist-Leninist-Maoist partisan republic created by Laurent-Désiré Kabila, who later became president of the Congo, after the failed Simba Rebellion. Wikipedia's list of historical unrecognised states gives its capital as Hewa Bora and its dates as 1967 to 1986.

entries_new.name: Emirate of Imbaba
entries_new.stopped_by: Siege by more than 12,000 police and security forces
entries_new.mechanism: An armed group claimed control of a Cairo district.
entries_new.story: In late 1992 the group al-Gama'a al-Islamiyya expanded its influence in parts of Imbaba, a district of Cairo, and purportedly announced an Emirate of Imbaba. According to Wikipedia's list, the challenge to the Egyptian state led to a siege starting on 8 December, in which the government used over 12,000 police and security forces and bulldozers, ending the emirate.

entries_new.name: Republic of Toumoujagha
entries_new.mechanism: Rebels announced a state online during a Tuareg uprising.
entries_new.story: In 2007, according to Wikipedia's list, a group allegedly made up of Tuareg rebels proclaimed over the internet the independence of a republic covering the Tuareg regions of Mali and Niger. It happened during the 2007 to 2009 Tuareg rebellion. The list gives no capital.

entries_new.name: South West State of Somalia break with the federal government
entries_new.mechanism: A federal member state cut ties with the central government.
entries_new.story: On 17 March 2026, according to Wikipedia's list, the South West State of Somalia severed ties with the federal government over Somalia's constitutional crisis and allegations by State President Abdiaziz Laftagareen of an attempted coup against him by federal forces. The list notes commercial flights between Mogadishu and Baidoa were halted.

entries_new.name: Kengwei Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Absorbed by the Dagang kongsi
entries_new.mechanism: Chinese miners ran a self-governing mining republic in what is now Indonesia.
entries_new.story: The Kengwei Republic was a kongsi republic, a self-governing mining community, established by Hakka Chinese at Monterado in what is now Indonesia. Wikipedia's list says it belonged to the Heshun Confederation, accepted Dutch overlordship in 1823, and was eventually absorbed into a stronger kongsi, Dagang.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Santiaogou Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Dutch annexation
entries_new.mechanism: Chinese miners ran a self-governing mining republic and allied with local and Dutch powers.
entries_new.story: Also known as the Sanda Futing or the Hexian Zhengting, the Santiaogou Republic was a kongsi republic, a self-governing mining community, in what is now Indonesia. Wikipedia's list says it allied with the Sultanate of Sambas and later the Dutch East India Company, yet the Dutch annexed it. Its members kept mining until 1857.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Lintian Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Dutch colonial government
entries_new.mechanism: Chinese settlers ran a self-governing mining republic before Dutch colonial rule ended it.
entries_new.story: The Lintian Republic, also called the Xinle Republic, was a kongsi republic, a self-governing mining community of Chinese settlers, with Budok as its capital. Wikipedia's list says it emerged late compared with most other kongsi republics, briefly joined the Heshun Confederation in 1850, and was dissolved by the Dutch colonial government.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Republic of Zamboanga
entries_new.mechanism: Residents of Zamboanga formed a breakaway state.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Republic of Zamboanga as a short-lived Zamboangueño breakaway state, existing from 1899 to 1903, with Zamboanga as its capital in what is now the Philippines. The list gives no further detail on who led it or how it ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Tianjin Provisional Government
entries_new.mechanism: Foreign powers governed a Chinese city during the Boxer Rebellion.
entries_new.story: The Tianjin Provisional Government was formed by the Eight-Nation Alliance during the Boxer Rebellion in China. Wikipedia's list says it controlled the city of Tianjin and its surrounding areas from 1900 to 1902. The list gives Tianjin as its capital and no further detail on how it began or ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Great Han Sichuan Military Government
entries_new.mechanism: Sichuan broke away from central authority in 1911.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Great Han Sichuan Military Government as a short-lived Sichuanese breakaway state that existed from 1911 to 1912, with Chengdu as its capital. The list gives no further detail on who led it or how it ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Uryankhay Krai
entries_new.mechanism: A region left the Qing dynasty and then became a Russian protectorate.
entries_new.story: Uryankhay Krai was a short-lived protectorate of the Russian Empire proclaimed on 17 April 1914, with Kyzyl as its capital, according to Wikipedia's list. It was created from the Uryankhay Republic, which had recently proclaimed independence from the Qing dynasty of China in the Mongolian Revolution of 1911.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Sultanate of Tarim
entries_new.mechanism: A division of power within a sultanate left one town with its own ruler.
entries_new.story: The Sultanate of Tarim was a state in Yemen created after a division of power within the Kathiri sultanate in 1916. Wikipedia's list says Muhsin ibn Ghalib al-Kathiri first ruled it, and a body called Jam'iyat al-Haqq handled civil affairs. In exchange for keeping control of Tarim, the al-Kaf family gave the Kathiri sultanate a monthly stipend.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Autonomous Government of Khorasan
entries_new.mechanism: A military state was proclaimed in Iran.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes this as a short-lived military state set up in Iran. It was formally established on 2 April 1921 and collapsed a few months later, on 6 October 1921. The list gives Rasht as its capital.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Tungus Republic
entries_new.stopped_by: Ceded back to the USSR in 1925
entries_new.mechanism: An uprising among the Tungus proclaimed a state.
entries_new.story: The Tungus Republic was a short-lived state started by the Tunguska uprising, part of the Yakut uprisings of the 1920s. Wikipedia's list says it had Ayan as its capital in Russia and was ceded back to the Soviet Union in 1925.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Northwest Chinese Soviet Federation
entries_new.mechanism: Two minority-led Communist governments formed a confederation.
entries_new.story: The Northwest Chinese Soviet Federation was a confederation of two ethnic minority governments established on 30 May 1935. Wikipedia's list says it joined the Gyalrong Revolutionary Government of the Republic of Geledesha with the Tibetan People's Republic. Its capitals were Mao, Barkam, Jinchuan and Garzê.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Tibetan People's Republic
entries_new.mechanism: A Tibetan Communist-aligned government formed part of a federation.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Tibetan People's Republic as the ethnically Tibetan half of the Northwest Chinese Soviet Federation. It existed in 1936 with Dêgê as its capital. The list gives no further detail on who led it or how it ended.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Azerbaijan People's Government
entries_new.stopped_by: Reclaimed by Iran
entries_new.mechanism: The Soviet Union backed a government in northwest Iran.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Azerbaijan People's Government, based in Tabriz in Iran, as a Soviet puppet state set up in Iranian Azerbaijan but later reclaimed by Iran. The list gives no dates and no further detail on who led it.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: People's Republic of Jeju Island
entries_new.mechanism: Local people's committees acted as the government of the island.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the People's Committees on Jeju Island functioned successfully as a de facto government, meaning a government in practice, with popular support. Their collapse eventually led to a rebellion on the island, which is now part of South Korea. The list gives no dates.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: People's Republic of Tyre
entries_new.mechanism: A Palestinian organisation ran the city of Tyre during the Lebanese Civil War.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the People's Republic of Tyre as an administration controlled by the Palestine Liberation Organization during the Lebanese Civil War. It emerged after the Savoy Hotel attack, in 1975, in the city of Tyre.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Corsican Republic
entries_new.mechanism: Corsica broke away from the Republic of Genoa.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the Corsican Republic seceded from the Republic of Genoa and existed from 1755 to 1769, with Corte as its capital in what is now France. The list says only the Bey of Tunis recognised it.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: The Gozitan Nation
entries_new.stopped_by: Became part of the British protectorate of Malta
entries_new.mechanism: Rebels took Gozo from the French and ran it under a provisional government.
entries_new.story: The Gozitan Nation was an independent kingdom under the Neapolitan King Ferdinand III, according to Wikipedia's list, but it was actually ruled by a provisional government set up by Saverio Cassar after French troops on the island capitulated to rebels. It became part of the British protectorate of Malta in 1801.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Senate of Western Continental Greece
entries_new.mechanism: A provisional regime governed western Central Greece during the war of independence.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Senate of Western Continental Greece as an unrecognised protostate during the Greek war of independence. A protostate is an early, provisional form of state. It was a provisional regime in western Central Greece in the early stages of the war, with Missolonghi as its capital, from 1821 to 1823.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Areopagus of Eastern Continental Greece
entries_new.mechanism: A provisional regime governed eastern Central Greece during the war of independence.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Areopagus of Eastern Continental Greece as an unrecognised protostate during the Greek war of independence. A protostate is an early, provisional form of state. It was a provisional regime in eastern Central Greece, with Amfissa as its capital, from 1821 to 1825.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Military-Political System of Samos
entries_new.mechanism: A provisional regime governed Samos during the war of independence.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Military-Political System of Samos as an unrecognised protostate during the Greek war of independence. A protostate is an early, provisional form of state. It was a provisional regime on the island of Samos, with Vathy as its capital, and lasted from 1821 to 1834.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: United Provinces of Central Italy
entries_new.mechanism: Piedmont-Sardinia set up a joint military government over four former states.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the United Provinces of Central Italy as a short-lived military government established in 1859 by the Kingdom of Piedmont-Sardinia after the Second Italian War of Independence. It was formed by a union of the former Grand Duchy of Tuscany, the Duchy of Parma, the Duchy of Modena and the Papal Legations, with Modena as its capital.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Canton of Cartagena
entries_new.stopped_by: Invasion by the Spanish government after six months
entries_new.mechanism: A city declared itself an independent canton and fought the central government.
entries_new.story: In 1873 Cartagena was proclaimed an independent canton, which began the Cantonal Revolution in Spain during the First Spanish Republic, Wikipedia's list says. Cantonalism was a movement for a federal state of autonomous cantons. Other places joined and surrendered within days. Cartagena alone had an organised government and military, and faced the Spanish government for six months until invaded.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Kruševo Republic
entries_new.mechanism: An uprising proclaimed a republic in a town for ten days.
entries_new.story: The Kruševo Republic was established in Kruševo, in present-day North Macedonia, at the start of the Ilinden Uprising. Wikipedia's list says it lasted ten days, from 3 to 13 August 1903, and calls it one of the first modern governments with leftist views. Its president, Nikola Karev, and co-writer of the Kruševo Manifesto, Nikola Kirov, were socialists.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Autonomous Republic of Northern Epirus
entries_new.mechanism: Local Greeks declared self-government in southern Albania.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list describes the Autonomous Republic of Northern Epirus as a short-lived, self-governing entity founded on 28 February 1914 by the local Greek population of southern Albania, known as Northern Epirotes, in the aftermath of the Balkan Wars. Gjirokastër was its capital.

sources.t: Wikipedia: List of historical unrecognized states

entries_new.name: Free State of Schwenten
entries_new.stopped_by: Joined the Weimar Republic
entries_new.mechanism: A local government declared independence to avoid being drawn into a Polish uprising.
entries_new.story: Wikipedia's list says the Free State of Schwenten was an independent state proclaimed in 1919 with its capital at Schwenten, now Świętno in Poland. The declaration had a defensive purpose, because the local government knew of the Polish uprising in Greater Poland. It existed for seven months before joining the Weimar Republic.
